pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

experiment: E8, the bench of the chart (protocol section 14)

views.machine: the whole frame and the columns 2 .. last - 1 of the inside of the image; the rest is set to zero in normalised units, after the frame is drawn

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: the judge H: plus network, mu = 1, half A, whole image; the same at the three values of v
keys.z_H0: the judge without the bias: same seed and half, frame independent of the class
keys.z_M: log-odds of each machine on its own, shape (3, N), rows in the order of `machines`; for Mramo z_M + z_branch; Mblind is the same at the three values of v
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames, the same at the three values of v
machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class

machines.M: cross-entropy on half B, on the machine's part of the image
machines.Mramo: M frozen (eval mode) plus a branch that sees only the frame, trained from scratch on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_M + z_branch; recorded cue z_M + z_branch
machines.Mblind: a network that sees only the frame, trained from scratch on half B on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_blind (H frozen)

frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
torch_seeds: crc32('chart/<task>/s<seed>/<H|blind|M|ramo>') & 0x7fffffff; H0 has the seed of H; M and the branch have the same seeds at the three values of v

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

deviations: shared GPU: the driver stopped twice to give the GPU back to another user and started again when it was free. Three sessions on 2026-11-19, UTC: 09:49 to 10:15, 10:19 to 11:27, 19:20 to 20:13. A unit is written when it ends; the units under way at a stop were run again from the start, with the same seeds. stage_time is the last session only: the seconds of each unit are in unit_seconds
all the 75 units were written in the second session
environment built again for these runs: numpy 2.5.5 (E1 to E5: 2.5.4); python, torch, torchvision, CUDA and cuDNN as in E1 to E5
